name: Camber
description: A road crowned in the middle: the arch flattens as it runs down the sheet.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 2%; bottom: 6%; width: 96%; height: @calc(92 - 72 * @y / @Y)%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); border-radius: 999px 999px 0 0; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
